Finds the tops of the trees as the points of a lidar survey higher than all the others around them.

**Toolbox folder:** Lesto › vegetation<br>
**Status:** Draft<br>
**Keywords:** Local maxima, las, lidar<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello, Silvia Franceschi<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.lesto.modules.vegetation.PointCloudMaximaFinder`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inLas` | LAS file |  |  | The lidar data: a las file, the index file of a folder of las files created by LasIndexer or a las database. |
| `inDtm` | raster file |  |  | The dtm raster that gives the height of the points over the ground, and the area of interest if no roi is given. |
| `inRoi` | vector file |  |  | A set of polygons to use as region of interest. |
| `inDsmDtmDiff` | raster file |  |  | An optional dsm-dtm difference raster to use to check on the extracted tops. |
| `pMaxRadius` | double |  | `-1.0` | The radius within which a point has to be the highest to be a maximum. With the dynamic radius it is its upper limit, ignored if not larger than 0. |
| `doDynamicRadius` | boolean |  | `true` | Use an adaptive radius based on the height. |
| `pElevDiffThres` | double |  | `3.5` | With the dsm-dtm difference, the largest difference of a top from the cells around it. |
| `pThreshold` | double |  | `0` | The height over the ground up to which the points are left out. |
| `pClass` | String |  |  | The comma separated list of classes to filter (if empty, all are picked). |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outTops` | output file |  | The output local maxima. |

**References**

- Popescu, S. C., Wynne, R. H. (2004). Seeing the trees in the forest: using lidar and multispectral data fusion with local filtering and variable window size for estimating tree height. Photogrammetric Engineering & Remote Sensing, 70(5), 589-604.
